content: The DTC-specifc Flash Protect Lamp shall be set to Unavail- able / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemProtectLampIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .
